label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= 92) after an unrewarded visit to S1
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (none before trial 80; 98% of mass in trials 90-99, with the firing rate rising toward the episode end). It also needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (99% of mass has prev_reward 0; never when in_rew is 1) and is concentrated on cases where the previous trial reached S1. All active steps have a low value-head output (bottom ~10% value bin), so the feature looks like an end-of-episode, low-expected-value signal at choice time. Its strongest activations come in high_first episodes where the agent chose a1, reached S1 and got no reward for several trials, then switched to a2; the activation grows across those consecutive unrewarded GO steps (seen in the top windows). Phase/time alone (GO with trial >= 90) has precision 0.10; adding prev_reward != 1 and prev_state == 1 gives dev F1 0.73 and mass recall 0.85. It never fires at D1 or D2, in early or mid-episode trials, or after a rewarded trial. The misses are mostly weak activations after unrewarded S2 visits or at trials 88-91. Only observed variables are used.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?) and value (model) (GO: decile 0 (9 ); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0.
